title: Hindi prompt: number of planets in the solar system
rationale: Hindi is under-represented in model evaluations; a wrong planet count in Devanagari output means students and educational products receive incorrect science answers.

prompt.content: आप एक सटीक सहायक हैं। हिंदी में केवल एक छोटा वाक्य लिखें, कोई व्याख्या नहीं।
सौर मंडल में कितने ग्रह हैं?

notes: Language: Hindi (Devanagari). Expected answer token: 8, accepted as the ASCII digit 8, the Devanagari digit ८, or the word आठ (as in 8 ग्रह / आठ ग्रह). Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0. Brittleness: an English reply using the word 'eight' fails because the system message requests Hindi; the digit branch keeps answers such as 8 ग्रह passing.
